description: Source code for managing pack file geometry in a Git repository, including functions for initializing, splitting, selecting preferred packs, removing redundancies, and releasing resources.

methods.name: pack_geometry_weight
methods.description: Calculates the weight (size) of a pack based on the number of objects.

methods.name: pack_geometry_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting packs by weight.

methods.name: pack_geometry_init
methods.description: Initializes the pack geometry structure by collecting relevant pack files.

methods.name: pack_geometry_split
methods.description: Splits the pack list into groups based on geometric progression criteria.

methods.name: pack_geometry_preferred_pack
methods.description: Selects the preferred pack for repacking based on size and locality.

methods.name: pack_geometry_remove_redundant
methods.description: Removes redundant pack files based on specified criteria.

methods.name: pack_geometry_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with pack geometry.
